name: Ballroom
author: amp
description: A swarm of spheres in a bright room, jostling on the beat. Eighteen styles that drift on their own — chrome, glass, painted pottery, orb fields, translucent porcelain, veined marble, raymarched gyroid lattices, gold in frosted glass — with screen-space global illumination and reflections. Now and then a cloud of leaf blows through and sticks to the balls: ↑ calls it, ↓ sends it away. WebGPU only.
